tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i brjod don gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa bzhugs/
༄༅/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i brjod don gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i brjod don gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid/ rgyas sras ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa der 'dud/ /gang dag tshe 'di'i bya ba'i spros spangs nas/ /ri sul dgon pa dag tu gnas bcas te/ /thos bsam nyams len don du gnyer 'dod pa'i/ /dad ldan rnams kyi 'jug bya bshad pa bya/ /de yang rang cag rab tu byung ba thams cad kyis 'jug par bya ba'i gzhi ni thos bsam sgom gsum yin la/ khyad par du ri khrod mdzad pa rnams kyis ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang*/ lha sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam gzhag legs par shes dgos shing*/ shes na ci ltar rigs pa bsgrub dgos pas 'dir ni de'i rnam gzhag cung zad bshad pa bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang*/ lta sgom spyod gsum dang*/ nyams len kun gyi snying po gzhan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul dgod pa dang*/ de dag gi don bsdus nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu las/ mkhas pa'i gzhung du gzhi la tshul gnyis te/ /lung dang rigs pas sgro 'dogs gcod gzhi dang*/ /dri ma sbyong ba'i byed pa 'jug pa'i gzhi/ /dang po ltar na bden pa gnyis yin te/ /don dam spros dang bral nas yod mtha' dgag /kun rdzob sgyu mas med pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /sgro skur rtag chad la sogs mtha' gnyis kyi/ /lta ba ngan pa'i gdon las grol bar bya/ /phyi ma ltar na dri bcas sems kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa dang*/ /dri ma 'bral du rung ba'i glo bur bar/ /shes nas khams sbyangs phyir du brtson par bya/ /dri ma dag byed dngos ni stong pa'i lam/ /'on kyang lam 'dis dri ma bag chags dang*/ /bcas pa ma lus dag par byed pa ni/ /mtha' yas bsod nams tshogs la rag las pas/ /sems mchog gnyis sogs rgya chen spyod pas ni/ /ngoms mi shes par chu bo'i rgyun ltar sbyad/

/de ni rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa'i lam/ /phyogs rer 'chel ba byis pa dga' skyid tsam/ /zab mo ye shes tshogs las chos sku dang*/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs las gzugs sku gnyis/ /grub pa 'di ni 'bras bu'i mthar thug ste/ /rim bzhin rang gzhan don gnyis mchog gi gzhi/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ dri bcas sems kyi rang bzhin gzhi/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba lam/ /chos dang gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'bras/ /gzhi lam rnam gsum bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum las/ gzhi yi lta ba snang stong zung 'jug ste/ /lam gyi nyams len tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel/ /'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug lhun gyis grub/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras lags/ /zhes dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang nas/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel du goms pas/ sku gnyis zung 'jug tu thob ste/ don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs la/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung 'bum las kyang*/ gzhi bden gnyis rnam dbye rtogs pa'i blo/ /thabs byang chub sems kyis rtsis zin pa/ /lam stong nyid snying rje snying po can/ /'di chos kun yang snying mthar thug lags/ /lam de 'dra sgoms pa las byung ba'i/ /sgrib bral gyi yon tan nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mthar thug gi zung 'jug phyag rgya che/ /sku gsum gyi bdag nyid 'bras bu yin/ /zhes dang*/ gzhi bden gnyis kyi gzhung tshul snyad pa de/ snang ba dang stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /de thabs kyis zin pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /lam thabs shes kyi nyams len mi zer ram/ /sgrib bral gyi zab rgyas dbyer med pa/ /'bras dus kyi zung 'jug e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams kyi don thams cad gzhi lam 'bras gsum du 'du zhing*/ /de gsum gyi ming gi tha snyad kyis dngos su gsungs pa dang ma gsungs pa gnyis ka yod la/

mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis gzhi dang*/ gsum pas lam dang*/ bzhi pas 'bras bu bstan te/ dang po gnyis kyis gzhi bden gnyis sam khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la bden grub gsar du bsal bar bya ba ci yang med cing*/ bden med gsar du bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang med de/ shes bya'i gzhi de dag grub tsam nas sam gdod ma nas bden par grub pa med pa'i phyir zhes bstan/ gsum pas de ltar rtogs pa'i lta ba de lam du bstan/ bzhi pas de lta bu'i lam de bsgoms na grol bar 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu de bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum la da dung so sor phye na mang ste/ grub mtha' bzhi'i lugs kyi gzhi bden gnyis dang*/ lam thabs shes dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub la 'dra mi 'dra du ma dang*/ theg pa gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lugs kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum spyir mtshungs kyang nang gses kyi mi 'dra bar du ma yod de/ dper na/ nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams kyis ni gzhi bden gzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam bsgoms pas rang gi byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can rnams kyis gzhi gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs pa'i lam bsgoms pas rang gi byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs can rnams la sems tsam pa'i rigs can rnams kyis gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i lam dang*/ dbu ma pa'i rigs can rnams kyis bden med rtogs pa'i lam bsgoms nas rang gi 'bras bu byang chub 'thob par 'gyur bar bshad pa lta bu dang*/ sngags la'ang rgyud sde bzhi so so'i nyams len la nang gses kyi mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod pa'i phyir rang rang thun mong ma yin pa'i gtan la dbab bya'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag kyang cung mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod de zhib par ni rang rang gi gzhung du bltas pas shes so/

/'on kyang de dag kun gyis ni/ gzhi bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag shes nas/ lam thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su blangs na/ 'bras bu thar ba thob par 'gyur ro zhes 'dod pa ni 'dra'o theg chen pa ltar na/ gzhi kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag legs par shes nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsogadon dam gyi rnam gzhag shes nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsog de 'dra ba'i thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis bsags nas 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'thob par 'gyur zhing*/ de yang rin chen 'phreng ba las/ bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams kyi tshogs las gzugs sku dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs las chos sku thob par 'gyur zhes bzhed pa ni theg chen pa'i grub mtha' rnams 'dra'o/ /des na gzhi lam 'bras gsum la spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par mang du 'byung zhing*/ spyi'i dbang du byas pa'i gzhi ni bden pa gnyis te/ de gnyis kyi khyad par legs par shes dgos shing*/ lhag tu mgon po klu sgrub kyi lugs kyi bden gnyis dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bshad pa ltar shes dgos so/ / gal te shes na legs mod/ ma shes kyang skyon med do snyam na ni mi rung ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de las nyams pas thar ba 'grub yod min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir 'dir yang bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad na 'brel mod/ mang du dogs pa dang gzhan du bdag gis bshad zin pas gzhag go /lam la spyir theg pa gsum gyi lam dang*/ lam lnga'i tha snyad mdzad pa sogs yod kyang*/ smin byed kyi lam dang grol byed kyi lam gnyis su 'du'o/ /nges 'byung dang byams snying rje sems bskyed lta bu smin byed kyi lam gtso che la/

bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ni grol byed kyi lam dngos so/ /'bras bu la spyir mtha' yas kyang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi 'bras bu ni byang chub gsum dang*/ khyad par du sangs rgyas sam sku gsum gyi 'bras bu la go bar bya'o/ /༈ gnyis pa lta sgom spyod gsum la gnyis/ mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul dgod pa dang*/ don bsdus nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje'i gsung 'bum las/ rtag dang chad pa spangs pa lta ba ste/ de yi don la rtse gcig 'jog pa sgom/ /sdom gsum spyod pa gtsang ba spyod pa ru/ /shes par gyis la de ltar nyams su longs/ /zhes dang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsum 'bum las/ yin lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa lta ba ste/ /bying rgod bral ba'i nyams myong sgom pa yin/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba spyod pa ste/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa 'bras bur 'dod/ /ces dang*/ rkyen gyis ma bcos ngo bo 'gyur ba med/ /rang bzhin rnam dag gshis la bzang ngan bral/ /kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin gdod ma'i gshis/ /spros pa'i mtha' bral rtogs pa lta ba yin/ /rnam rtog pir gyis ri mo bris pa las/ /yul gyi steng nas grub pa ma mchis kyang*/ /ming tsam nyid la 'khor 'das bya byed kun/ /'thad par shes pa gnas lugs mthong ba yin/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed don rnams la/ /so sor dpyod dang ri dbang bzhin du 'jog /'dod rgur dbang bsgyur bying rgod dang bral bas/ /ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed de sgom par 'dod/ /g.yo med shin tu brtan pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ /yin lugs so sor dpyod pa'i lhag mthong gnyis/ /zung du 'brel ba'i sgrib gnyis sa bon kun/ /spong par 'dod de sgom chen pa zhes bya/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ /gdod ma'i gshis la dbye ba ma mchis kyang*/ /tha snyad las 'bras bslu ba med shes nas/ /phyin drug nyams su len pa spyod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ /paṇa chen rin po ches kyang*/

/chos skye med dri bral 'dod ma'i gshis/ /'di gcer mthong lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ /don de nyid dran shes zhags pa yis/ /dus rgyun du 'ching ba sgom pa'i gnad/ /nang bdag 'dzin rten phur drungs phyung nas/ yul ci dgar spyod pa spyod pa'i mchog /ces dang*/ bden 'dzin gyi 'ching ba bshig byas te/ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa/ /rang bzhin dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid/ /ji bzhin du rtogs pa lta ba'i mchog /'khor 'das kyi rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*/ rnam dag gi rigs pas mdung bskor bya/ /g.yeng med du chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /rtse gcig tu 'jog pa sgom pa yin/ /don dam du spros pa kun bral yang*/ /rjes thob tu khyer so gsum gyi ngang*/ /rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i rjes slob pa/ /skyon med kyi rlabs chen spyod pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ rang sems la sogs 'khor 'das chos kun/ /bden pa'i dngos po rdul tsam med par/ /rtag dang chad pa spangs pa'i dbyings de/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa lta ba'i rgyal po/ /don dam spros bral zab mo'i dbyings de/ /bying rgod skyon rnams legs par bsal te/ /dran dang shes bzhin gad+gā'i rgyun bzhin/ skyong bar byed pa sgom pa'i rgyal po/ /rjes thob mnyam bzhag rtse yis zin pa'i/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor ngang nas/ /sgo gsum sdig bral dge ba'i lam du/ /ci dgar 'jug pa spyod pa'i rgyal po/ /de lta'i lta sgom spyod pa'i tshul 'di/ /sgyu mas rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams kun gyis/ /ji bzhin rtogs par gyur na dga' ba/ /rtogs par gyur nas grol na skyid pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de dag ni gtso bo theg pa chen po'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir lta sgom spyod gsum ni phyi nang gnyis dang/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa thams cad kyis bzhed cing*/ byang chub sgrub pa la nges par dgos pa'o/ /lta sgom spyod gsum la ming 'dra yang don mi 'dra ba mang du yod de/

bdag med phra rags rtogs tshul gyis phye ba dang*/ khyad par du grub mtha' rang rang gis 'dod tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang*/ der ma zad 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par lta ba sogs lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i sgo nas bzhag pa sogs te skabs thob shes dgos so/ /lta ba mchog ni bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba yin la/ de la rnam grangs mang yang mgon po klu sgrub kyi lugs dpal ldan zla ba dang rje rin po ches bshad pa ltar chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong par rtogs pa'i lta ba de nyid lta ba thams cad kyi mchog yin no/ /sgom pa la dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gnyis te gtso bo ni phyi ma'o/ /spyod pa la spyir mang yang 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang*/ phyin drug gi spyod pa dang*/ thos sogs la 'jug pa sogs te/ mdor na sgo gsum sogs dge ba la 'jug pa'i spyod pa thams cad do/ /sngags kyi skabs su thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa gsum la sogs pa mang ste/ de dag gi khyad par phal cher ni lung drangs pa rnams kyi don du gsal lo/ /lta spyod gnyis mi 'gal te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ni lta spyod gnyis su phye ba'i lta ba yin kyang spyir spyod pa yang yin te rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la phar phyin drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa nyams len gyi snying po gzhan bshad pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nyams su len rgyu la spyir mang yang snying bo'i dbang du byas na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum dang*/ bslab gsum dang*/ sngags kyi rim gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ paṇa chen rin po ches/ chos phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /don gces pa'i brjod bya mchog gyur ba/ lam stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ zhes dang*/ bka' mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po mchog /chos stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/

/'di kun gyis nges na a la la/ /don nges nas grol na e ma ho/ /zhes dang*/ lam stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /'di chos kun gyi yang snying mthar thug lags/ /zhes dang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la/ /chos kun gyi snying khu de'o de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'o na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes pa de ci 'dra ba zhig la byed ce na/ de ni rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu las/ theg pa chen po spyi skad kyi stong nyid snying rje snying po can zhes pa/ da lta'i rnal byor pas skyong ba na stong nyid kyi lta ba'i nyams myong brtan pa'i rtse ma zhig par sems can la snying rje chen po skye ba la bya dgos la/ /gsang sngags bla med nas stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med bshad pa phal mo che khams gnyis kyi zhi bde la brten nas de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i bde stong dbyer med la bkral ba mang zhes gsungs te snga ma ni thun mong ba dang*/ phyi ma thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ skabs 'dir ni snga ma ltar ro/ /de ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag lta bu la gnas nas de'i mjug de ma thag mnyam gzhag gi rtse ma yal ba'i ngang nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bral 'dod tsam ma yin par/ skyabs 'dod kyi snying rje chen po skyes pa zhig dgos kyang*/ de min gzhi bdag gam sems can nam phung po sogs la don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad pa'i mthar de ltar rang bzhin stong yang sgyu ma bzhin du snang ba'i sems can la dmigs nas skyes pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du bya'o/ /de'i tshe snying rje des sems can bden med du rtogs par mi 'jog kyang sems can bden med kyi rnam pa can du shar bar 'jog go /snying rje chen po ni thog tha bar gsum du gal che zhing sangs rgyas kyis chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bur bshad cing*/

sems bskyed skye ba dang gnas pa dang gong 'phel du byed pas spyod pa khyad par can gyi rten yang byed do/ /snying rje la rigs gsum yod kyang dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po ni snying rje gzhan gnyis las khyad par du 'phags shing*/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen zhes pa'ang snying rje de lta bu la dgongs so/ /phar phyin gyi gzhung che ba rnams kyi skabs du mar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje chen po gnyis kyis zin pa'i ye shes zhes 'byung ba phal cher ni/ mnyam gzhag khyad par can gyi ngang nas stong nyid rtogs pa dang*/ de'i shugs sam rtse ma yal ba'i snying rje chen pos zin pa la dgongs shing*/ 'ga' zhig ni stong nyid rtogs pa tsam dang snying rje chen po spyi'i dbang du mdzad do/ /zin pa'i don la dngos su zin pa dang rtse ma yal bar zin pa dang brgyud nas zin pa gsum ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje lta bu ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas dngos su zin pa yin la/ byang 'phags kyi snying rje la lta bas dngos su zin ma zin gnyis dang*/ so skye'i snying rje'i lta bu la lta ba'i shugs ma yal bar zin pa 'ga' zhig yod kyang*/ phal cher brgyud nas zin pa tsam ste/ lta ba dang snying rje lhan gcig tu tshogs dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /sngar sems bskyed pa nyams nas dman pa'i lam du gyur pa rnams ni sems bskyed kyis zin par 'jog mi nus kyang*/ stong nyid kyi lta ba las nyams zhes pa'i tha snyad dngos su gsungs pa ma mthong bas/ stong nyid rtogs pa sngon du song ba tsam gyi sems bskyed sogs ni lta ba des zin par 'jog pa'am/ yang na nyams ma nyams kyi khyad par phye nas khas blang bar bya'o/ /lta bas dngos su zin pa ni lta ba dang lhan cig tshogs dgos par bshad pa yod kyang*/ lta ba'i rtse ma yal ba la lta bas dngos su zin par 'jog pa'i skabs ni yod par mngon te/

mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi las langs ma thag pa'i skabs 'ga' zhig lta bu'o/ /rgyal tshab rin po ches phar phyin ṭik+kar/ sems bskyed rnam mkhyen dran pa'i 'dun pa du re ba yod pas tshe des dngos su zin pa dang*/ med pa'i dus su des dngos su ma zin par bshad pa yang lhan cig dngos su tshogs ma tshogs kyi dbang du mdzad pa ste/ zin bya gang yin zin byed de dang de dngos su zin ma zin pa'i khyad par cung dbye dka'o/ /so skye'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo gcig nyid kyis stong nyid dang kun rdzob cig car du rtogs par bzhag dka' yang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i tshe blo zur ba zhig gis ni kun rdzob rtogs pa la 'ga' ba med de/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du go ba'i gang zag gis myu gu rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i blo de nyid kyis myu gu rten 'brel yin pa la nges pa 'dren nus pa dang*/ rten 'brel yin par go ba'i blo nyid kyis rang bzhin med pa la nges pa 'dren nus par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /blo gcig gis de ltar nges pa 'dren nus kyang blo gnyis so so bar mngon te/ nges shes ni blo snga ma'i stobs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad so skyes stong nyid la dpyad sgom byed pa'i tshe nges don kun rdzob kyi snang ba med pas theg chen sems bskyed dang snying rje lta bu med kyang*/ de'i dus su rgyud la de dag yod pa mi 'gal te gnyid kyi dus su de dag yod pa 'dod dgos pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang bka' brgyud pa sogs kyi lugs la phyag rgya chen po zhes nyams len gyi snying por mdzad pa'i phyag chen de ni mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs ltar na stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba sgom pa yin la/ de la yang dpyad sgom 'jog sgom gnyis dang*/ 'jog sgom la zhi lhag gi phyogs gnyis yod cing*/ lhag mthong la ni dpyad sgom kyang yod do/

/spyir nyams su len pa'i rim pa khyad par ba ni/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/ nam 'chi nges med bsam pa/ /nyams len gyi bskul ma ru 'dug pa/ /byams dang snying rje sgom pa/ /nyams len gyi sna 'dren du byas so/ /byang chub sems gnyis sgom pa/ /nyams len gyi dngos gzhi ru 'dug pa/ /dge rtsa dmigs med kyi ngang nas/ /sems can thams cad la bsngo ba/ /nyams len gyi mjug sdud du byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gzhan yang*/ chos thams cad rang rang gdags gzhi la/ /phar rtog pas btags tsam kho na las/ /don yul gyi steng nas ma grub pa'i/ /dpal 'phags pa yab sras bzhed pa'i don/ /zhes pa nas/ don rjen pa nyid du lhang gis rtogs/ /chos gang shar 'bad rtsol ma dgos par/ /rang ngo bos stong bar lam lam shar/ /rjes ming tsam sgyu ma'i rten 'brel la/ /lar bya byed thams cad 'thad shes pas/ /nyams nga ba chad lta'i g.yang las grol/ /zhes dang*/ chos rnams kun gyi gdod ma'i gshis ya/ /rang bzhin stong pa de'o de yin no/ /'khor 'das thams cad rnam rtog gi ri mo/ /tha snyad rten bral de'o de yin no/ /bdag pas gzhan ces byang chub sems*/ /theg chen 'jug sgo de'o de yin no/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la/ chos kyi nying khu de'o de yin no/ /phyin drug gi nyams len 'di*/ /rgyal sras kyi spyod pa de'o de yin no/ /'khrul med kyi bskyed rdzogs nyams len/ /zab lam mthar thug de'o de yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ khyad par du yod med kyi mtha' gnyis bsal nas snang stong zung 'brel la nges pa 'dren tshul ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung mgur las/ dbyings spros bral gdod nas dag pa dang*/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yi/ /yul snang stong res 'jog ma yin pa'i/ /don zung 'jug mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ /lam 'di 'dra rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes dang*/ chos can kun bltas pas sgyu ma tsam/

/chos nyid la bltas kyang cang ma mthong*/ /sgyu ma dang stong pa zung 'brel lam/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /a la la yod med kyi mtha' dang bral/ /mtha' bral gyi dbyings su mnyam par gzhog /chos nyid la bltas pas chos can bkra/ /chos can la dpyad pas stong par bros/ /snang stong gnyis res 'jog mi byed pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /don dam gyi rgyu 'bras bslu med bstan/ /kun rdzob kyis don dam rang zhal phye/ /bden gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /don dam gyi dbyings la dpyad pa'i tshe/ /rten 'brel gyi ming yang med pa dang*/ /stong pa dang rten 'brel zung 'jug 'di/ /'gal med du bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyi rnyed/ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa/ / bden med du shes pas bden pa go /bden gnyis ky-i rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /ming rkyang gi chos rnams bden pas stong*/ /bden stong kun rgyu 'bras rol par shar/ /stong pa dang rgyu 'bras dbyer med lam/ /e ma ho bla ma'i drin gyi rnyed/ /a la la rtag chad kyi g.yang las grol/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi snang bas yod mtha' dang*/ /stong pas med mtha' sel tshul legs par dgongs pa'i nyams mgur ro/ /yang de nyid kyis/ ye gdod nas ci yang ma grub pas/ /yul bdag med rtogs pa'i nges shes kyis/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par rtogs/ /da chad pa'i g.yang la nyam nga med/ /yang rten nas 'byung ba'i chos rnams kun/ /snang tsam gyis sgyu ma'i rol bar mthong*/ /de mthong bas a 'thas 'ching ba zhig /don de phyir rtag pa'i mtha' las grol/ /nga stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ba/ /yul gang shar rdzun pa'i rgyas thebs pas/ /khong bden par 'dzin pa'i chom rkun po/

/gzhi skye med gdod ma'i dbyings su bros/ /lar 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /ming btags yod tsam gi rol pa las/ /dbyings ngo bo ci yang ma mchis pas/ /da skye 'chi gnyis la nyam nga med/ /sngar dal med 'khyams pa'i ngal gso'i gnas/ /chos stong nyid bdud rtsi'i snying po rnyed/ /'di bsams shing rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ drin che bar nges so bla ma rje/ /nga blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sras/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du dad pas bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ par gyi yi ge pa ni dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i khru shi'i dge slong ri khrod pa kun dga' nor bu'o// //sarbamad+ga lam//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/gzhung lugs chen po'i brjod don gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs/ -PAGE 418--PAGE 417--PAGE 404-
